attendance_source.method: Sum the 32 published finals date/venue/attendance headings (736000) and divide by 32 matches. RSSSF is a specialist football-statistics archive; published rounded values are retained, not replaced by ticket distribution figures.

revenue.basis: No trustworthy tournament-specific revenue figure established. Prize money, host budgets and CAF fiscal revenue are not tournament revenue. BBC ticket prices cannot establish revenue: distributed tickets include free tickets and do not imply attendance. Contemporary Reuters source returned HTTP 401 twice.

sources.quote: The Confederation of African Football (Caf) will say these finals were the best attended ever, with nearly 800,000 tickets either sold or distributed.

notes: Attendance is RSSSF published match-heading total / 32; BBC tickets sold or distributed are not counted as spectators.
No verified 2013 tournament-specific revenue obtained. Host budget, prize pool, multiyear broadcast rights, CAF fiscal totals, and later-edition revenue are not substituted.
Browser teardown/navigation failures were recovered using Scrapling page_action DOM capture; raw sources and exact execution failures retained.
